args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20), B LONG, C DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE U (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_U PRIMARY KEY, TID LONG, V TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20))
SELECT A FROM T ORDER BY A;
SELECT T.ID AS Key1, T.A AS [Label], B * 2 AS Twice FROM T;
PARAMETERS pId Long, pName Text ( 20 ); SELECT ID, A FROM T WHERE ID = pId OR A = pName;
PARAMETERS pId Short, pName Text ( 10 ); SELECT ID, A FROM T WHERE ID = pId OR A = pName;
SELECT ID FROM T WHERE B > pMin;
SELECT T.ID, U.V FROM T LEFT JOIN U ON T.ID = U.TID;
SELECT A, Count(*) AS N, Sum(B) AS SB FROM T GROUP BY A HAVING Count(*) > 0;
SELECT ID, A FROM T ORDER BY A DESC, ID ASC;
SELECT TOP 2 ID FROM T ORDER BY ID;
SELECT TOP 50 PERCENT ID FROM T ORDER BY ID;
SELECT DISTINCTROW T.A FROM T INNER JOIN U ON T.ID = U.TID;
TRANSFORM Sum(B) AS SB SELECT A FROM T GROUP BY A PIVOT ID;
SELECT ID, A FROM T UNION SELECT ID, A FROM W UNION ALL SELECT ID, V FROM U;
INSERT INTO W (ID, A) SELECT ID + 100, A FROM T;
UPDATE T SET B = B + 1 WHERE ID = 1;
SELECT ID, A INTO TNew FROM T;

SELECT  ID ,A
FROM T
WHERE A = 'it''s' OR A = "q"
SELECT ID AS [Bä€] FROM T WHERE A <> 'Bä€ 𝄞';
SELECT ID FROM T WHERE A LIKE 'a*';
SELECT ID FROM T WHERE A LIKE 'a%';
